summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Homeland Security to immediately resume construction of the border wall system along the U.S.-Mexico border using previously appropriated funds, prohibits the cancellation of related contracts, and mandates the submission of an implementation plan to complete the wall by September 30, 2026.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on resuming and completing the construction of a border wall system along the U.S.-Mexico border, which is a direct measure aimed at securing borders and restricting unauthorized entry. It also mandates DNA collection at border facilities, further tightening border controls. The bill's title, 'Finish the Wall Act,' and its provisions clearly indicate its primary purpose is to enhance border security.
